THE ECHO BELOW · SCENE
15 · Bugbears and Droop · area 9
Change prepared scene
Say aloud

Three large figures occupy the room as though it belongs to them. A goblin nearby flinches at your arrival and looks ready to disappear into the floor.

The room's sleeping places and the positions of those inside shape the space available for an approach. You have a moment to note who watches you, who avoids your gaze, and where the door sits behind you. Words are still an option before the first movement becomes an attack.

Ask the players

Do you speak, fight, retreat, or try to separate the goblin from them?
